avalanche.travel_advice: Watch for signs of unstable snow such as recent avalanches, cracking in the snow, and audible collapsing. Avoid traveling on or under similar slopes.

facts.text: Snow left Sawmill Ridge (4,640 ft) and Corral Pass (5,810 ft) 6 to 14 days earlier this year than the median of the three earlier seasons on file (2023 to 2025).

evidence.name: Sawmill Ridge
evidence.detail: left April 29; earlier seasons: May 19 (2023), May 13 (2024), May 6 (2025)

evidence.name: Corral Pass
evidence.detail: left May 26; earlier seasons: May 30 (2023), June 16 (2024), June 1 (2025)

facts.text: This year's highest snow water on or after April 1 was the third highest of the four seasons on file (2023 to 2026) at Corral Pass (5,810 ft) and the lowest at Sawmill Ridge (4,640 ft).

evidence.name: Sawmill Ridge
evidence.detail: 10.1 in on April 2; earlier seasons: 39.3 in (2023), 21.6 in (2024), 17.6 in (2025)

evidence.name: Corral Pass
evidence.detail: 28.5 in on April 4; earlier seasons: 42.0 in (2023), 26.3 in (2024), 33.9 in (2025)

facts.text: An estimate: snow left the pass itself between April 11 and June 3, carried from the melt-out dates at Sawmill Ridge (4,640 ft) and Corral Pass (5,810 ft) to the pass elevation.

evidence.name: Sawmill Ridge
evidence.detail: melted out April 29, 288 ft below the pass; points to April 10 to May 28

evidence.name: Corral Pass
evidence.detail: melted out May 26, 882 ft above the pass; points to April 12 to June 8
